items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: When Mr. Sarnoff was alive and in power he dreamt of having the same thing you would have in Europe

ctx.x: Which, you attribute that to the bean counters?

Oh greed, greed. When Mr. Sarnoff was alive and in power he dreamt of having the same thing you would have in Europe, you know. I fortunately through the years have worked with Munich with the Rundfunk in Munich and Stuttgart and most of the good German orchestras, the Neudautsche in Hamburg. I worked with wonderful orchestras there. And of course the BBC through the years, but that too is going by the wayside. The second orchestra in the BBC is gone now.
The musicians over the years that you’ve worked with in TV and in the studio have contained a lot of our best jazz musicians.
